question: What is the name of the mentorship initiative launched by IIT Delhi for high-school girls?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Manasvi.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **IIT Delhi has launched ‘Manasvi’, a STEM mentorship initiative to inspire high-school girls towards careers in Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics (STEM).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The programme, named ‘Manasvi’, aims to address gender disparities in STEM fields and inspire high school girls to pursue careers in these areas.**
 
• Led by IIT Delhi’s Academic Outreach and New Initiatives Office, the initiative focuses on equipping girls with the necessary skills and confidence.
 
• Manasvi seeks to provide mentorship and guidance, fostering an interest in STEM and helping reduce gender gaps in these traditionally male-dominated fields.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Gender Disparities in STEM__

 __
 
• Women are underrepresented in STEM fields, and initiatives like Manasvi aim to close this gap by encouraging more young women to pursue these careers.
 
 
 
• IIT Delhi's Role__
 __
 
• Indian Institute of Technology Delhi (IIT Delhi) plays a crucial role in shaping India’s educational landscape, especially in the fields of science and technology.
 
 
 
• Academic Outreach and New Initiatives Office__
 
 
• The office at IIT Delhi leads various outreach programs aimed at broadening the scope of education and making it more inclusive.
